card.name: Start of words ending in -led
card.fires_on: Partway through a word whose next piece would be 'led' or 'ked', such as coun-se-led, dul-led, bul-ked. The marked piece is an early part of a verb, often a past-tense form.

card.plain: It fires in the middle of a word that is about to end in 'led', such as counseled or dulled.
